passage.label: Al-Baqarah — murder dispute resolved by striking with cow part; hearts hardened like stones; some hear Allah's word then distort it knowingly after understanding

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذۡ قَتَلۡتُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَٱدَّـٰرَ ٰٔتُمۡ فِيهَاۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخۡرِجٞ مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ
فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِبُوهُ بِبَعۡضِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحۡيِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِيَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةٗۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمَآءُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَهۡبِطُ مِنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
۞أَفَتَطۡمَعُونَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ لَكُمۡ وَقَدۡ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ

وَإِذَا لَقُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Murder case dispute among Bani Israel resolved by striking slain man with part of the cow, demonstrating Allah's power to revive the dead and show signs for reasoning; subsequent hardening of hearts becoming like or harder than stones; party among them hearing Allah's word then deliberately distorting it after understanding, while knowing

subordinateSubjects.label: Killing a person and disputing over it
Allah bringing out what they were concealing
Command: strike him with part of it (the cow)
Thus Allah brings the dead to life and shows signs for reasoning
Hearts hardened after that, like stones or harder
Some stones burst forth rivers, split open with water, fall from fear of Allah
Allah is not unaware of what they do
Party hearing Allah's word then distorting it after understanding, knowingly
Hypocritical profession of faith when meeting believers
Private concern: sharing revelation enables believers to argue before Lord

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Hardening of hearts (qaswat al-quloob) as spiritual deterioration after witnessing signs
Deliberate distortion (tahreef) of divine word after understanding it
Hypocrisy: professing faith publicly while concealing disbelief privately

notes: Pass A pilot 5, passage 13/4. Connects cow narrative to murder resolution. Introduces tahreef (distortion) and qaswat al-quloob (hardening of hearts) as key theological concepts.
